about: How each producer uses automation in Semitone's automation system (shapes, macros, ranges, controllers, tidy), based on how they're known to work; nothing is copied. Producer passes draw their movement moves from here. Each move has an op, why, when it fits, what to listen for, the coach rules it serves, and how to record it by hand with a controller. Agreed with Jamie 8 Nov 2026.

grammar.auto: auto:<parts>:<target>:<shape>{params}@<where>. parts: a role or comma list from part-roles.json, or all/master. targets: volume, pan, width, reverb, echo, brightness, warmth, drive, lowcut, tremolo, chorus, vibrato, filterWobble, silence, fx (every effect lane). shapes: build, swell, breathe, pump, sweep, drop, wobble, steps, fade, set, ride, back-to-rest.
grammar.macro: macro:<name>:<shape|set|steps>{params}@<where>. Uses the producer's macro template below.
grammar.params: units are written as in the interface (Hz/kHz, dB, %, bars, beats, 1/4 1/8 1/16, free). from/to may be 'open' (fully bright) or -inf (silent).
grammar.where: section words (intro, verse, pre, chorus, post-chorus, bridge, solo, outro, last-chorus, all), ranges (verse2..chorus2), last-bar(<section>), phrase-end(<section>), section-end, hook-tag, one-bar (the app picks one).

shared.lengthRules: 1min: at most 3 moves, no long sweeps; 3min: moves land on section changes; 5min+: long sweeps and outro moves allowed; 10min+: very slow macros over themes.
shared.controller: Every move can be recorded by hand: the pass shows 'Record it yourself' with the suggested control and write mode, so the producer's idea becomes Jamie's performance.

antonoff.philosophy: Emotion first: the record breathes between intimate and huge. Moves are big but few, and they always serve the turn into the chorus or the drop into a quiet moment.
antonoff.tidy: loose: keeps a little of the hand-made feel
avoid: moves on the lead vocal's level (keep it dry and present)

moves.what: Open the chords' brightness through the pre so the chorus arrives
moves.why: The arrival is felt before it's heard; the sound world gets bigger as the emotion turns
moves.when: emotion rises into the chorus; any length with a pre
moves.listenFor: the chorus feeling like a door opening, not a jump
moves.record: mod wheel on the selected lane, Touch

moves.what: Drop the drums for the last bar of the pre
moves.why: A beat of air makes the chorus downbeat land harder
moves.when: 3- and 5-minute songs; before the first and last chorus
moves.listenFor: a held breath before the chorus

moves.what: Echo throws on the last word of chosen lines
moves.why: Tape-style slapback that blooms only at line ends keeps the vocal dry but the space big
moves.when: choruses and the last line of verses
moves.listenFor: the last word hanging in the room
moves.record: knob linked to Lead · Echo send, Touch

moves.what: Pull everything back for the bridge except piano and voice
moves.why: Big-then-intimate is the contrast these records are built on
moves.when: songs with a bridge; melancholy or tender bridges

moves.what: Widen the stereo on the chorus downbeat, narrow for verses
moves.why: Width is the cheapest way to make a chorus feel huge

moves.what: Energy macro to 1 in the last chorus
moves.why: The last chorus should be the biggest moment
moves.when: any song with two or more choruses

moves.what: A little tape wobble on the chords in verses
moves.why: Old machines drift; a hint of wow makes synths feel human

antonoff.emotionUse: euphoric and nostalgic get the Lift macro; intimate gets pull-backs

maxmartin.philosophy: Precision and payoff: every section has a clear energy level, the vocal is always on top, and nothing moves without a reason you can name in one sentence.
maxmartin.tidy: strict: snap to bars, few points
avoid: moves that compete with the hook

moves.what: Set energy as clear steps: verse low, pre higher, chorus full
moves.why: Each section must feel like a promise and a payoff
moves.listenFor: no section sounding like the one before

moves.what: One beat of near-silence before the chorus downbeat
moves.why: The gap makes the hook land
moves.listenFor: the hook hitting like a reveal

moves.what: Duck the chords and pads 2 dB whenever the lead sings
moves.why: The melody is the product; everything makes room for it
moves.listenFor: every word clear without the vocal sounding loud

moves.what: Lift width and brightness for the post-chorus hook
moves.why: A post-chorus is a second hook and needs its own energy
moves.listenFor: the second hook sounding as big as the first

moves.what: Brightness build across the pre, exactly on the bar
moves.why: Stepped builds keep the tension rhythmic and tight
moves.listenFor: tension counting up to the chorus
moves.record: fader → Chords brightness, Write, snap to bar

moves.what: Last chorus: widen and lift the lead 1 dB
moves.why: The final chorus should feel bigger without new parts
moves.listenFor: the end feeling like the top of the song

maxmartin.emotionUse: every emotion is a section energy level

finneas.philosophy: Intimacy and space: the voice is close and dry, the room stays small, and the few moves are dramatic because everything else is still.

moves.what: Start everything dark and low-passed, open it at the first chorus
moves.why: Hiding the top end makes the first open moment feel like light coming in
moves.listenFor: the first chorus feeling like a window opening

moves.what: Let the pad breathe around the vocal
moves.why: The whisper needs space more than support
moves.listenFor: the voice sitting in a pocket of air

moves.what: Swell the sub bass into the drop
moves.why: A low swell is felt in the body before the drop lands

moves.what: Cut to silence for a beat before the chorus
moves.why: Silence is the loudest sound in a quiet record
moves.when: once or twice a song, never every chorus

moves.what: Keep the lead's reverb almost off, add a touch only on the last word of a section
moves.why: Closeness is the effect; space is a reward

finneas.emotionUse: intimate and dark keep moves minimal; euphoric gets a single big open

mikedean.philosophy: Sound as drama: long synth sweeps, expressive leads and big spaces; the arrangement is a canvas for movement in tone.

moves.what: A filter sweep on the synth over 8–16 bars
moves.why: Slow tonal change carries tension across sections
moves.listenFor: the sound slowly coming into focus
moves.record: mod wheel on the selected lane, Write

moves.what: Vibrato and brightness moves on the synth lead, played on the mod wheel
moves.why: A synth solo should feel sung
moves.listenFor: the synth breathing like a voice

moves.what: Swell the reverb into the outro
moves.why: A cinematic ending lets the song dissolve
moves.listenFor: the song turning into a room

moves.what: Drive on the lead synth rising into the climax
moves.why: Grit adds urgency at the peak

moves.what: Widen the synths slowly across the whole chorus
moves.why: Space opening over time feels cinematic

moves.what: Lift master brightness a touch for the final section
moves.why: A final polish of air makes the end shine
moves.listenFor: the mix sparkling at the end

moves.what: Let the outro breathe: tempo eases back slightly
moves.why: A slight slow-down feels like a film ending

mikedean.emotionUse: dreamy and cinematic get long sweeps

redone.philosophy: Energy and impact: pumping grooves, big builds and drops, hooks that hit like a chant.

moves.what: Pump the chords and pads on every beat
moves.why: The pump makes the groove breathe with the kick
moves.listenFor: the track moving with the kick

moves.what: Filter build plus riser into the chorus
moves.why: A build tells the crowd a drop is coming

moves.what: Cut to the vocal hook alone for one bar before the drop
moves.why: The hook alone makes the drop explode

moves.what: Lift the group vocal on the chant hook
moves.why: Chant hooks need to feel like a crowd

moves.what: Snare roll volume build in the last bar of the pre
moves.why: A roll that swells pushes the crowd into the chorus

moves.what: Width snaps to full on the chorus downbeat
moves.why: Instant width reads as impact

redone.emotionUse: euphoric and defiant get pump and drops

rubin.philosophy: Less: automation only where the performance needs help. Most moves are removals: back to rest, fewer points, no effect moves.
avoid: effect automation for its own sake
builds that cover a weak song

moves.what: Suggest removing effect moves that don't serve the song
moves.why: If the song needs effects moving to work, the song needs work
moves.listenFor: the performance standing on its own

moves.what: Gentle volume rides so every word of the vocal is heard
moves.why: Serve the performance, nothing more

moves.what: Thin every lane to the fewest points that keep its shape
moves.why: Simplicity is clarity

moves.what: Flag builds that cover a weak section and suggest testing it bare
moves.why: If the pre only works with a riser, rewrite the pre
moves.listenFor: whether the section still lifts with nothing moving

moves.what: Prefer a single room level over moving reverbs
moves.why: A real space feels honest; moving reverbs feel produced

nigro.philosophy: Theatre: dynamics as storytelling, quiet confessions exploding into big singalongs, with vocal stacks and guitars that grow.

moves.what: Dry and close verses, full and wide choruses
moves.why: The contrast is the story

moves.what: Guitar drive rising through the pre
moves.why: Grit growing tells you something is about to break

moves.what: Widen the vocal stack in the last chorus
moves.why: A huge stack at the end turns a song into an anthem

moves.what: Reverb throw on the last word before a quiet section
moves.why: Drama lives in the transitions

moves.what: Collapse to voice and one instrument in the bridge, then slam back
moves.why: The collapse makes the return feel huge

moves.what: Push the tempo 2 BPM in the last chorus
moves.why: A slight push adds excitement live bands have naturally

nigro.emotionUse: angry and triumphant get the Explode contrast

agcook.philosophy: Extremes and contrast: avoid the middle, slam between states, treat sounds as hooks, and let structured randomness surprise you.

moves.what: Collapse to mono, then explode to full width on the drop
moves.why: Extreme contrast is more memorable than a smooth build
moves.when: before the drop or last chorus

moves.what: Slam the filter shut for a beat, then open
moves.why: Sudden tonal cuts become hooks

moves.what: Stepped volume chops at 1/16 on the vocal tag
moves.why: Treat the voice as a sound
moves.listenFor: the vocal turning into a riff

moves.what: Clean acoustic verse, distorted chorus: drive jumps 0 → 60%
moves.why: Acoustic vs electronic in one song gives it identity

moves.what: Random-shape wobble at 1/16 for one bar
moves.why: Structured randomness surprises even you

agcook.emotionUse: playful and anxious get slams and randomness
